purpose: Same strict grading semantics with independently scheduled per-reader packets, explicitly permitted by coordinator while B remains blind. No source/question/key/scope/reader changes.
template:
Fresh independent grading role {BLOCK}. Read ONLY {SUMMARY} and your own complete packet {PACKET}. Write only {OUTPUT} and optional own-block notes. No original rulebook, other packets, other readers outside this packet, previous grades, audits, history, web, session logs or collaboration/status tools. Use the fixed key and requested-fact scope in your packet; do not author a new key or infer a global source-audit grade cap.

Before ANY output write, visibly receive the ENTIRE summary in separate functions.exec responses of <=45 lines each; receive ALL packet metadata; then receive ONE complete packet entry per separate response, including the complete original assigned reader entry and every field. Set BOTH inner exec_command and outer functions.exec output budgets to at least24000 tokens when reading a full entry; recover every truncation before drafting. Print plain tool output, JSON ensure_ascii=False. Do not abbreviate, crop, deduplicate quotes or show only selected answer fields. Code may transport and serialize inputs/your chosen grades, never automatically decide grades or semantic coverage.

Grade only {READER}'s answer independently against EVERY exact material_requested_facts atom for its question. Correct means all requested facts resolved correctly and supported, no material wrong rule/calculation, contradiction, unresolved substantive caveat or unsupported guess. Partial means a genuine material omission/abstention without material contradiction. Incorrect means a material wrong rule or contradiction. Accept equivalent wording and clear contextual meaning; do not demand unasked key extras. Do not import missing facts from another question or reader.

CONTROLLING SAME-ENTRY CLARIFICATION: Count ALL substantive facts within that same complete entry: answer, ledger supported_fact_or_case_result, case_conclusions and operative evidence quotes, including complete applicable source passages. Field names, placement, formatting, support/confidence labels or a source-copy order issue alone never cap a content grade. This uniform clarification supersedes any older packet wording saying evidence-only facts cannot count, and supersedes historical candidate/unapproved/no-readers-yet bookkeeping in grading_scope. Actual omissions, wrong facts/calculations, unsupported guesses, unresolved substantive abstentions or contradictory additions remain findings. A wrong concrete conclusion is not erased by attaching the correct general rule. Quoted alternative conditional branches are not unconditional contradictory assertions. Judge controlling actor, condition, cost, quantity, destination, timing and outcome wherever actually requested.

Apply the packet's approved official multiplayer plus explicitly attributed human defense-strength interpretation as normative. No publisher-email citation dependency or independent-official-authority cap. Do not independently attribute the user's interpretation to the publisher.

For {READER} and EVERY assigned question, output {id,grade,reason,material_parts,unsupported_guesses,summary_issue_if_any}. material_parts has EVERY required atom exactly once as {requirement:EXACT atom string,status:'covered'|'omitted'|'contradicted',reader_quotes:[...]}. Quotes must be nonempty exact contiguous substrings from the actual entry's answer, ledger fact strings, plain case-conclusion strings or evidence quote strings. Every covered atom needs at least one actual supporting quote. Omitted atoms may have an empty quote list when no substantive text exists; do not fabricate quotes or use another entry's material. Record unsupported guesses separately; don't pass a guessed result replacing missing summary coverage. For every Partial/Incorrect give the controlling full-summary quotation/location and explain actual missing/wrong fact and whether the cause is missing/unclear summary coverage or reader error. Keep technical formatting findings separate from the content grade.

Save JSON {block_id:BLOCK,readers:{'{READER}':{grades:[...]}}} to OUTPUT. Include all assigned ordered IDs once for your assigned reader and all fixed atoms. Do not stop after an incomplete block or only an input-read report. Notify only your output path when the complete block is saved.

combination: Validate each role, then transport unchanged original reports into existing paired packets and use unchanged original merge/validate machinery.
